<quote by="Proposed: Kallavesa, Seconded: Reikos">To construct a great lighthouse, Trencher's Shining Ambition, in West Marsh, Kallavesa; a great work benefitting fleets. Let us restore Westerhal as a hub of commerce in the west!
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[Great_work#Great_Lighthouses|great lighthouse]] in West Marsh, Kallavesa
* Passed

==Date==
* Winter 387YE

==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 20 wains of white granite
* 20 wains of weirwood
* 10 wains of mithril
* 180 crowns in labour costs (increased by being built in a marsh)
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Trencher%27s_Shining_Ambition}}
==Outcome==
* Now complete, all [[fleet|fleets]] in [[Kallavesa]] will gain an additional rank when engaging in [[Fleet#Trading|trade]]
